findings.current: He stared in silence at the man blocking it before asking, “How did you know I was here?”
findings.defect: This repeats the preceding sentence’s description of Jeok Cheongang silently staring at the man blocking the cave entrance before speaking. The Korean has that action only once.
findings.rationale: The source describes the silent stare once, then has Jeok Cheongang ask how Mungyeong found him.
findings.replacement: “How did you know I was here?”

findings.current: A fine sword kept its edge no matter how many years passed.
findings.defect: The source specifically attributes the sword’s lasting sharpness to the skill of the blacksmith who forged it; this version omits that image.
findings.rationale: The Korean says that a sword forged by an outstanding blacksmith does not grow dull with time; the accepted baseline preserves the forging image.
findings.replacement: A sword forged by a master blacksmith never lost its edge, no matter how many years passed.

findings.current: He had simply laughed because he did not know what else to do.
findings.defect: The translation drops the explicit contrast that he was laughing neither from happiness nor from feeling hollow.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly rules out both happiness and 허탈함 before explaining that he laughed because he did not know what else to do; the accepted baseline preserves both contrasts.

summary: The assembled copy is mostly faithful, but it duplicates an action and drops several source details preserved in the accepted baseline.
